text:
nora-docs: Heads-up  opened a lightweight PR to update the Archimedes-9B model card with variant names, conservative seq limits, and a tiny SDK v2 example showing the `profile` param: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1420. Need a quick sanity check on numbers and any bad links.

ben-eng: Skimming now. For the q4 variant we validated default safe max_seq=3072, but the `high-memory` profile was stable up to 6144 on orion-class runs. Recommend we present default vs profile-enabled numbers clearly and mark hardware dependency.

olivia-devex: CI shows a broken anchor from the card to the profiles doc: card points to `#runtime-profiles` but the canonical doc uses `#profiles`. link-checker flagged it.

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 failure  sources/docs/model-catalog/archimedes-9b.md: anchor '#runtime-profiles' not found.

nora-docs: I'll update the anchor and add a short explanatory blurb: "Default seq limits are conservative. Request `profile='high-memory'` to enable extended limits where supported (hardware dependent)." Also will include the v2 snippet.

ben-eng: For the snippet use `profile` param and add a commented note showing `archimedes-9b-fp16` as an alternative for latency-sensitive workloads. Also suggest a one-line indicative benchmark footnote: e.g., q4 ~42 tok/s @seq=1024 (orion, batch=1); high-memory @6144 ~20 tok/s. Include clear disclaimers.

olivia-devex: Add a short fallback sentence please: "If the selected profile isn't available the router may fallback to a compatible variant or another region, which can increase latency." Customers asked for explicit wording.

peggy-support: Can we mention the routing policy name ops uses when preferring profiles? Ops uses `prefer-profile`, might help oncall triage. A parenthetical reference would be handy.

nora-docs: Done  added fallback line plus parenthetical link to routing doc and the `prefer-profile` policy name. Fixed anchor. Snippet now:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
# request q4 variant with profile
resp = client.generate(model='archimedes-9b-q4_k_m', input='Explain TTI', profile='high-memory')
print(resp.text)
# swap to fp16 for lower latency: model='archimedes-9b-fp16'
```

ci-bot: pr-check: doc-lint passed, link-checker passed.

ben-eng: tiny suggestion  move the benchmark numbers into a footnote with test conditions (batch=1, beam=1) and a non-normative disclaimer. Otherwise LGTM.

olivia-devex: Small copy edits pushed for tone and inline code ticks. Created a follow-up ticket to sweep older model cards for the `#runtime-profiles` anchor.

peggy-support: Approved from support side. Thanks for adding the `prefer-profile` note.

nora-docs: Merged. I'll watch integration logs and #support for user questions. :ship:
